what: A synthetic Firefly III 6.6.3 ledger for the migration tests: no real person, account or amount. The test server in crates/server/tests/common/firefly.rs serves these files the way Firefly's API v1 does: JSON:API items, meta.pagination and links.next, 4 items per page whatever limit is asked, Bearer token, GET only.

files.accounts.json: every account (GET /accounts?type=all); a type-less request gets only the 'normal' ones
files.groups.json: every transaction group; lists return all but the 'liability credit' one (group 2), and without type=all they leave out opening balances and reconciliations
files.balances.json: Firefly's current_balance per own account at each month end, worked by hand below (never computed by the test server)
files.map.json: the person's map from Firefly accounts to Coinroost accounts
files.other files: one list per remaining entity type, migrated as counts and gaps

traps: group 1: an opening balance from the initial-balance account
group 2: the store card's opening debt, a 'liability credit' that no type filter lists; only GET /transactions/2 returns it
group 5: one group with two journals (a split)
group 7: paying the card, a withdrawal between two own accounts
group 9 and 22: transfers merged by the hub, outflow id in external_id and both ids in the notes as ext=
group 11: USD to JPY, the yen in foreign_amount
group 12: 2026-03-31T21:30:00-05:00, in March as written and in April in UTC
group 13: a JPY journal, no decimals
groups 17-25: the May rows of spec/fixtures/bac-account with the same external_id, dates and amounts
accounts 10 and 22: an expense and a revenue account with the same name, one payee
